Prostheses can be suspended from the amputated limb using a variety of techniques, such as straps and suction.
Suspending the prosthesis by creating a vacuum between the prosthetic socket and limb using a pump has benefits over other techniques including improved limb health and mobility.
A new pump design will be tested by prosthesis users in the laboratory to verify its functionality during walking.
